fieldDefinitions.objectiveAchievement: The artifact's declared bounded research objective or uncertainty/admission decision is materially closed under its own scope. A negative/no-change/non-admission closure may count when it resolves the current bounded decision; mere lifecycle termination does not.
fieldDefinitions.boundedImprovement: The source establishes a scope-relative improvement/dominance or measured beneficial delta under a declared comparison. Plausible usefulness or an untested broad mechanism is insufficient.
fieldDefinitions.currentConsumption: The result/capability has actual downstream use by a named consumer/use path. Citation, availability, or evidence generation inside the originating experiment is insufficient.
fieldDefinitions.realizedBenefit: A beneficial downstream consequence attributable to that consumption is observed. Originating-experiment success alone is insufficient without a downstream consumption/consequence chain.
fieldDefinitions.broaderPromotion: Whether the source authorizes a broader shared service/protocol/generalization beyond its bounded result. Explicit no-go boundaries require NOT_AUTHORIZED.

oracleNotes.F17: Specificity improved on E008, but the frozen scientific objective remains open because no true-positive/downstream decision-changing pressure exists.
oracleNotes.F18: Support-bound revalidation beats both keep-all and expire-all on preserving/narrowing the correct clauses in this case; no downstream consumption is yet established.
oracleNotes.F19: Invariant-bound continuation succeeds while the three countermodels fail on the frozen case; no later downstream consumption of the research result is established.
oracleNotes.ACS9: Research result was implemented in named owner surfaces and re-consumed by fresh-Agent campaigns with measured post-implementation benefit.
